result.summary: Found 2 visual issues: a misaligned card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel and inconsistent favorite-icon styling in the 'Popular right now' list.

issues.description: The middle card (Smash Bros Burgers) in the 'Fastest near you' row is vertically offset lower than the adjacent cards, with its top edge and '20-30 min' badge not aligned to the same baseline as the neighboring cards.
issues.suggestion: Align all cards in the horizontal row to the same top baseline with equal image height and consistent badge inset positioning.

issues.description: Favorite heart icons in the 'Popular right now' list have inconsistent styling: the icon on Tokumaru Ramen Bar has no background scrim, while the icon on the pizza card below has a dark translucent circular background.
issues.suggestion: Apply a consistent circular scrim/background behind all favorite icons to ensure uniform appearance and contrast over images.
